title: Managing the band and booking dances in Arkansas
summary: Harry handled receipts and pay while Desdunes booked; Mr. Hooper booked Arkansas and arranged a dance for a white college crowd in Derrida.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: We played practically everything with that band. Uh-huh. And, when he was the booking agent, he'd go ahead of us. Uh-huh. And I was managing the band. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Uh-huh.

I'd pick up the receipts, pay off the man, and send his parada back to him. He bought a bus, and I'd send his bus fare back to him and his man's money for, you know, like a record guy. He booked for a while, and then we'd get to places and a place where pretty good dancing was going on. We had around Arkansas, we had Mr. Hooper, the mayor of Derrida's son-in-law, who booked us around that territory.
The mayor of Derrida, Louisiana had a son-in-law.
Yeah, Hooper, what is that, Hooper?

Yeah, Hooper. We played a dance in Derrida, I don't think they had a dance there for the college people in so many years. We got in a bus, went ballyhoo, and I don't think we was back an hour before the people was crying in the place. That's how bad they wanted a dance. But the only way we could get to give that dance is through Mr. Hooper going to see the old man. And he decided to break up at 11 o'clock. But I think we must have broke up by nine, because we started about two hours here at the time. So many people, you know, around there. Yeah, we came right off from the advertising and started playing the music for the dance. All the little lands around there, people that danced, they couldn't get over that. But we were playing for the white every time we'd go there, you know. But there was a lot of the colored dance, I guess something had happened, you know. Yeah. Well, our biggest plan was for the white. Oh, yeah. The colored people were so glad when they'd get a chance to hear. stuff
